limitations: Search results and documentation do not establish universal absence.

research_scope.query_scope: One actual bilingual search per resource, grouped in shared cached batches; additional suggested terms are explicitly proposed, not executed.

distinctive_capability: Exact task/due excerpts, explicit owner aliases and bounded relative-date resolution. An offline executable can be called by a small model and checked against an explicit task contract.
counterevidence: Underlying algorithms and task outcomes already exist in the alternatives.
An existing tool configured for this exact task may remove the need for a separate project.
Small synthetic tests cannot establish broad expertise or external demand.
A reviewed public prompt already asks for an action, owner, due date and supporting quote. The contribution is bounded executable verification and recovery, not that output format.
validation_hypothesis: The same small model completes the held-out structured job more accurately with this executable resource than without it.

prototype_budget.note: Shared implementation/research/test/publication budget is tracked at batch level; not a claim of actual elapsed work.
